description: Returns the official texts used to classify under a code: the legal notes of its section and chapter and the explanatory notes of the Combined Nomenclature for its heading and subheadings, as published by the European Union. Texts are in Spanish. Long sets are cut: the index lists every note with its identifier so that specific ones can be requested. Covers the EU customs tariff (TARIC) as applied in Spain (mainland and Balearic Islands). Not valid for the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla. For guidance only, not binding.

code.description: 2 to 10 digits: a chapter, heading, subheading or full code.

language.description: Language of the texts returned: Spanish (es), Catalan (ca) or English (en). Official EU texts not published in Catalan are returned in Spanish.

note_ids.description: Identifiers from the index, to get only those notes in full.

name: get_classification_notes
title: Classification notes for a code
